stem: In a certain large document, typing errors occur at random and at a constant mean rate of 0.2 per page.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that there are fewer than 3 typing errors in 10 randomly chosen pages.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use an approximating distribution to find the probability that there are more than 50 typing errors in 200 randomly chosen pages.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: In the same document, formatting errors occur at random and at a constant mean rate of 0.3 per page.
parts.text: Find the probability that the total number of typing and formatting errors in 20 randomly chosen pages is between 8 and 11 inclusive.
